title: The interval is never cleared
description: The effect returns no cleanup, so the interval keeps running after the component unmounts.

title: Cross-site scripting through dangerouslySetInnerHTML
description: Unsanitised text is rendered as HTML.

title: API key hardcoded in front-end code
description: Anything in the bundle is visible to every user.

title: Sensitive data requested over plain HTTP
description: Credentials and user data travel unencrypted.

title: Admin password hardcoded and sent from the browser
description: The admin password is in the bundle and in every request.

title: User passwords stored in localStorage
description: localStorage is readable by any script on the page.

title: API key stored in localStorage
description: localStorage is readable by any script on the page.

title: Searching replaces the user list
description: The filtered list overwrites users, so each search narrows the previous result and cleared searches never bring users back.

title: Infinite loop when a user has no name
description: processed only advances for users with a name, so the loop never ends at the first user without one.

title: The wrong users are updated
description: The response index (0-2) is used as the position in the users array, so the first three users change instead of the user with userId, and failed responses are ignored.

title: A million large objects put into state
description: Each click builds a million objects with 1,000-character strings and adds them to state, freezing the page and exhausting memory.

title: eval of user-supplied script
description: Running arbitrary text with eval allows script injection.

title: Prototype pollution in mergeUserSettings
description: Copying every key, including __proto__, from untrusted input can modify Object.prototype.

title: List items have no key
description: React needs a stable key per item to update the list correctly.

title: Passwords and card numbers shown on screen
description: Sensitive fields are rendered in the page.

title: Text typed in the search box is executed
description: Pressing Enter passes the input to eval.
